[Pending Restart] Aimed Shot now reduces healing taken by 35%, changed from 40%.
[Pending Restart] Mortal Strike now lasts for 8 sec, changed from 10 sec.

[Pending Restart] Periodic and absorb healing reductions from Infected Wounds, Shadow Embrace and Piercing Shots are now 15%, changed from 30%. (As these effects stack with normal healing reduction effects these could be too situationally strong.)

Fixed some issues where Southshore vs Tarren Mill guards could still end up as with hostility issues with cross-faction. This should fix Alterac Valley too!?

8.description: Terrifying Descent quest. Reduced the number of Terroguard required to 6. Now requires 6 Kil'sorrow Ritualist. This will will allow you to complete the quest much quicker while still promoting World PvP by having to fight over limited spawns.

2.description: [High-Risk][Alar][Area52] The addition of Criminal Qualms and Righteous Zeal will ensure more fair fights that ensure the outcome of these fights is in your control. If you are ganked mid farming, you will have a brief moment of hightened defense to properly assess, react and and gain a GCD to defend yourself. This also ensures "friendly" players cannot use criminal intent to create a perfect setup that places someone at a disadvantage with no counterplay. You should know when an enemy is approaching and have the ability to defend yourself properly. (Pending Restart)

[High-Risk][Alar][Area52] The changes to Honorable Combat resetting cooldowns will ensure 1v1 fights remain fair and confined to that specific battle. We saw players venturing into 1v1 as duos and forcing targets to trade cooldowns before disengaging, allowing their ally to engage with full cooldowns against a player without theirs. These players will no longer be able to fight without honor and you can slay these cowards in fair fights moving forward. Cooldowns being reset after Honorable Combat will also ensure No Retreat does not place you at an insurmountable disadvantage by being engaged back to back while unable to effectively escape from High-Risk. (Pending Restart)

[High-Risk][Alar][Area52] Slaying creatures in High-Risk with For the Horde/Alliance active will now grant you Righeous Zeal for 60 seconds, stacking up to 10 times. Righteous Zeal increases your resilience by 10 per stack, and is removed 5 seconds after taking damage from a player. Engaging in PvP prevents you from gaining stacks of Loyal Zeal for 3 minutes. (Pending Restart)

[High-Risk][Alar][Area52] Casting Criminal Intent will now apply Criminal Qualms for 8 seconds, reducing your PvP effectiveness temporarily. There was no counterplay to available against another player running on top of you and popping criminal intent. This will encourage using criminal intent preemptively and in a way that does put any player in a situation where they do not have meaningful counterplay. (Pending Restart)
[High-Risk][Alar][Area52] When 1v1 Honorable Combat ends and your enter into Respite debuffs preventing casting immunities like forebearance will be removed. (Pending Restart)
[High-Risk][Alar][Area52] When 1v1 Honorable Combat ends and your enter into Respite all combat cooldowns will be reset. (Pending Restart)
